Offsetting that, residual capture is as close to untouched as this screen ever sees - the stock is below its pre-announcement price, so nothing is harvested; the risk is that the vote is won and the business still does not re-rate, which is why I size this as a cheap asset-backed cyclical carrying a free option on a board sweep, not as an event trade.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: The line's own staleness charge is BACKWARDS and is itself the error. It claims Bergeron's "$187.5M liquidity" is "~$60M stale against the year-end sheet filed four business days before his letter." In fact $187.5M IS the year-end figure: Ethan Allen's own 2026-07-29 FY2026 release (FYE 2026-06-30) states it "ended the year debt-free with $187.5 million in cash and investments." The line's $127.9M / $5.03-per-share number is the defective one — it drops ~$59.6M of short-term investments (Q4 balance sheet reads shortTermInvestments $0 while otherCurrentAssets jumps $27.9M→$79.0M vs Q3; cash $73.628M + STI ~$59.6M + LTI $54.244M = $187.5M exactly). Correct asset floor is ~$7.37/sh, not $5.03/sh — 32% of the $22.77 price in cash+investments. One of the two stated reasons for capping at 6 dissolves, and the floor is materially STRONGER than underwritten. Everything else load-bearing CONFIRMS against primary sources: SC 13D filed 2026-08-05 (Bergeron/DGB), dissident DFAN14A 2026-08-05, company DEFA14A 2026-08-05 + 08-07, and the company's own release confirming "notice from Doug Bergeron of his nomination of six individuals" for the 2026 Annual Meeting; 5.0% beneficial ownership stated by both sides. Provenance holds cleanly — preferredStock $0, longTermDebt $0, no external manager, so the common captures 100%; the $120.4M "total debt" is entirely capital/finance leases, company is funded-debt-free. Market cap $579.4M ✓ exact, PP&E net $313.361M ✓, tangible book $426.3M → 1.36x ✓, ADV 410k sh ≈ $9.3M ✓, revenue $579M vs ~$1.05B FY2006 peak = −45% ✓. ALREADY-HARVESTED test PASSES genuinely: price $22.77 sits on its 200-day ($22.64) and just above its 50-day ($22.33), mid-range of a $18.28–$31.41 band — no announcement re-rate, nothing captured. Remaining real cap (correctly self-identified): G3 fails — Bergeron demands growth/digital/CEO succession, NOT a sale, breakup or monetization, so there is no contractual or derivable re-rate numerator; the payoff requires a multi-year operational turnaround against a CEO who already survived a 2015 proxy contest. Minor overstatements: no meeting date is actually set (no DEFC14A/PREC14A on file as of 2026-08-18, definitive proxy not yet filed), so "hard dated vote" and "competing WHITE/BLUE cards" are anticipated, not confirmed; and part of the $313M PP&E is leased-showroom ROU carrying value, not owned real estate. Score holds at 6 — the stronger-than-stated asset floor offsets the softer-than-stated vote mechanics, and the absent numerator is the binding constraint.

WIN (EU approval + supportive PREVAIL -> obicetrapib becomes a CV-outcomes statin-adjunct, 7MM peak ~$1.4B+, US-owned): re-rate to ~$60 (top of analyst range $37.77-$59.33; Street median $47.51; William Blair FV $43; one analyst 90% PoS, >100% upside). catalyst_3.evidence: The gap the line flagged as UNCONFIRMED closes AGAINST it, and worse than assumed: UX111 did receive a Complete Response Letter on 2025-07-11, cited to CMC observations and findings from recently completed MANUFACTURING FACILITY inspections; the BLA was resubmitted Jan 2026 and re-accepted with the Sep 19 2026 PDUFA. Because DTX401, if approved, is to be manufactured at Ultragenyx's own Bedford, MA gene-therapy facility, the two PDUFA legs are NOT independent binaries — a facility/CMC or reinspection failure is a shared failure mode that can take both down together, which removes the diversification the "three sequential binaries" framing implies. Everything else verifies against primary sources: DTX401 PDUFA Aug 23 2026 (BLA accepted with Priority Review, 52 patients, up to 6y follow-up), UX111 PDUFA Sep 19 2026, Aspire fully enrolled (~129 pts, full maternal UBE3A deletion, ages 4-17) with study completion/topline guided 2H26 — all forward, none fired as of today. Tape verifies exactly as claimed and passes the already-harvested test cleanly: $25.49 vs 52w high $39.89 (-36%), 200dma $26.55 (below it), 50dma $28.13, 52w low $18.29 (-28% floor), cap $2.51B — de-rated INTO the events, not run up. Q2 10-Q (filed 2026-08-05) confirms the capital-structure check verbatim: total debt $1.202B, cash+ST inv $292M + LT inv $150M = $442M, net debt $1.077B, stockholders' equity NEGATIVE $291M, accumulated deficit $4.809B. Two offsetting corrections: (a) management guided on the Q2 call to MONETIZING the priority review vouchers on both approvals as non-dilutive capital — a real, unmodeled cash offset to the debt objection; (b) the line's own concession is the binding one — the two PDUFA assets are ultra-rare/modest-revenue and unlikely to re-rate a $2.5B cap, so the entire asymmetry rests on Aspire, which was never sized. Net: an honest, correctly-dated, genuinely unpriced setup whose upside leg is unquantified and whose two "independent" near-term legs share a manufacturing failure mode. Holds as ACTIVE at reduced size; the defined-risk Oct/Nov call expression is the correct shape and should be treated as the recommendation, not the alternative.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: The named trigger does not exist: there is NO 2026-08-20 Q2 print. That is last year's date (DDL reported Q2 on 2025-08-20). The forward earnings date is 2026-09-02 (FMP, est., epsEst 0.070 / revEst $1.016B), ~2 weeks out, and NO 6-K scheduling it has been filed — EDGAR's last 6-K for CIK 1854545 is 2026-05-22 (Q1 ER), and Dingdong always files a 6-K to announce an ER date. So "a dated forward milestone three days out" and "the 2026-08-20 print is the clean, cheap test" are fabricated; the ACTIVE-tier urgency evaporates. SECOND CORRECTION — "the payoff is a fixed dollar amount" is false per the primary SPA disclosure: the $717M is "subject to adjustments based on certain net cash, net working capital and other financial line items"; the $280M extraction is partly self-cancelling ("if net cash of Dingdong BVI... minus the amounts received... is less than US$150 million, the Buyer has the right to adjust the purchase price cash consideration at closing for any such shortfalls"); and only 90% is payable at closing, with 10% held back until settlement of PRC non-resident indirect transfer tax (Bulletin-7, ~10% of the indirect-transfer gain) — real waterfall leakage the line waves off as "a tax bill." THIRD — the process gap is worse than stated: shareholder EGM approval is an explicit closing condition and 6+ months post-signing NO EGM has even been convened on EDGAR (no notice, no result), SAMR anti-monopoly clearance unconfirmed, outside date ~2026-02-05 +12mo. WHAT SURVIVES, and it is strong: the 2026-02-05 6-K confirms verbatim the executed SPA with Two Hearts Investments Limited (wholly-owned Meituan sub) for all shares of Dingdong Fresh Holding Ltd at "total cash consideration of US$717 million"; the 2026-02-10 6-K confirms verbatim the "prior to August 31, 2026" right to extract "total cash not exceeding US$280 million" and that "Dingdong Cayman expects that it will receive up to US$997 million in cash proceeds." The capital-return pledge is STRONGER than the line claimed — not "substantial majority" but "not less than 90% of the Company's cash balance after the closing... for share repurchase plans and/or dividends" — though still intent-grade, board-discretionary, with the company itself urging holders to "exercise caution." ALREADY-HARVESTED CHECK PASSES: announcement was a DE-RATE, not a re-rate — DDL closed $3.20 on 2026-02-04 and fell to $2.74 on 2026-02-05 (-14%, 26.0M shares) and now $2.29 (mktcap $496M). But the line mislabels its own number: -28% is measured from the $3.20 PRE-announcement close (which itself had run up from ~$2.76 in late Jan on leak), not "since announcement" (that is -16%). "Trades near the $1.65 52-week low" is also wrong — $2.29 is 39% above the low, sitting on its own 50dma ($2.26). Net: the discount-to-contracted-cash setup is real and primary-verified, better documented on the waterfall than claimed, but the tradeable trigger is wrong and the deal is stalled pre-EGM.

valuation.valuation_basis: Forced capital return. Definitive SPA to sell 100% of Dingdong Fresh Holding (substantially all China ops) to Two Hearts Investments (Meituan unit) for $717M equity transfer ($645.3M at close + $71.7M deferred post tax/leakage), plus up to ~$280M of additional cash via net-cash/working-capital/debt-like adjustments (~$997M potential). Shareholder resolution (Mar 27 2026 AGM passed) authorizes board to deploy >=90% of post-close cash to buybacks/dividends. Base case distributable = 0.90 x $717M = $645M / 216.5M ADS = ~$2.98/ADS; residual stub ~$0.20 (retained 10% cash + listed shell). Live $2.425 (mkt cap ~$525M) sits below the cash haul.
valuation.prob_basis: Gating risk = China SAMR anti-monopoly clearance + NDRC filing on the Meituan transaction; ADS unit count 216.5M (ADS:ordinary = 2:3, traded/quoted unit = ADS). Conservative cash bridge: the RMB3,210.6M (~$447M) net cash largely sits INSIDE the China entity being sold, so distributable cash ~= the $717M proceeds, not proceeds+existing. Upside: if adjustments add ~$150M, return rises toward ~$3.50/ADS. Floor = undisturbed ~$1.90 (pre-announcement level; 52wk low $1.65).

catalyst_3.evidence: Every load-bearing fact survives primary-source check, but the framed EDGE does not. CORRECTION 1 (price, stale and in the thesis's favor): last print is $40.49 (−2.53% on the day, prev close $41.54), not the ~$41.5 implied by "3.6% below $43.08". GFL is 6.0% BELOW the pre-announcement print, below its 200dma ($41.10) and 21% off the 52wk high ($51.40) — so attack (7) fails cleanly: nothing has been harvested, this is the rare unfired-AND-unpriced setup the line claims. CORRECTION 2 (the reviewer conceded unverifiable specifics that ARE verifiable, and they are favorable): the US FTC cleared 2026-05-05; only Canada's Competition Bureau remains, reviewing since May with Dovigi guiding 3–5 months on the 2026-04-30 call (i.e. Aug–Oct); the outside date is 2026-11-01, extendable up to 90 days for regulatory approvals — a bounded, dated window, not open-ended. THE CUT (why 5, not 6): the thesis's engine — "+12–15% accretion is EXCLUDED from guidance" — is a bookkeeping convention masquerading as hidden information. Every acquirer excludes unclosed deals; GFL published the 12–15% figure in the April 13 release and has been headlining "significant likely upside from SECURE" since. This is the single most-telegraphed number in the story, public and sell-side-modeled for four months. So the claim "the market priced the dilution and none of the accretion" is asserted, never demonstrated. The parsimonious read of a stock 6% below pre-announcement is that the market IS pricing something real: Competition Bureau risk on a Western-Canadian waste consolidation by a serial consolidator the Bureau has already reviewed once (Terrapure), a ~25% share-issuance overhang, leverage re-levering to low-to-mid 3s after GFL spent 2025 deleveraging, a Q2 miss ($0.14 vs $0.17 est, $162.6M net loss from continuing ops), and — decisive for attack (6) — a mix shift toward SECURE's oil-and-gas-levered energy waste, a structurally more cyclical and lower-multiple stream than GFL's solid-waste core. The ~$47 / +13.6% residual is a CONSTANT-MULTIPLE pro-forma: it converts company-stated FCF/sh accretion 1:1 into share price while assuming the multiple survives a deterioration in earnings quality. That assumption is the entire residual and it is unearned. Note also the 0.4195 exchange ratio is fixed, so the quoted accretion was struck at April share prices. Instrument framing is right (acquirer common, NYSE/TSX, $14.1B cap, ~3.0M sh/day — fully tradeable, no hidden disqualifier), and the $50 take-private chatter is correctly zero-weighted (Seeking Alpha 2026-07-27 explicitly says no formal offer exists). Genuine signed-unfired event with a hard date and no run-up, but the mispricing is a discount for real risks, not a blind spot.

The $7.65/MUX-share copper mark is the company's BASIC-share figure; fully diluted it is ~$6.57, and the line's $23.50 fair value at a $2.0B McEwen Copper post becomes ~$20.2 — margin over $18.36 shrinks from ~28% to ~10%. ALREADY-HARVESTED TEST FAILS TO BITE — the strongest point in the line's favor and it did not claim it: $18.36 vs 52wk high $29.70 (-38%), 52wk low $9.93, below both the 50d ($18.16) and 200d ($20.91) averages. This is a de-rated tape, not a pre-catalyst run-up. Score cut 6 to 5 on the undated/unvenued trigger plus diluted-share overstatement, not on harvesting. The residual structural weakness: by the line's own arithmetic a $300M raise on a $987.5M pre-money is value-NEUTRAL, so the event delivers zero cash to the common and forces no revaluation — the entire payoff is the public market choosing to price McEwen Copper above a stale private mark, with ~$4B of capex and further MUX-diluting equity raises ahead of 2029-30 first production. CORRECTION 1 (date): on the Q2 call management guided the minority-stake process to the FIRST HALF of 2027, "targeting H1-2027, close as early as possible," with the process taking several months AFTER the Q4 close — not the line's "late-2026/early-2027." The crystallizing leg sits ~2 quarters later than stated, pushing it to the far edge of a 12-18mo hold. CORRECTION 2 (already-harvested, partial): the line narrates $32.95 but RCI trades $35.91 today, +14.2% off the 07-06 base of ~$31.45 (52wk low $31.38) — roughly 22-31% of the modeled move is already captured. The line's own +28-45% math is computed off $35.91 so the arithmetic survives, and the stock is still below its 200-day ($36.69) and well below the 52wk high ($41.14), so this is a trim, not a kill. PROVENANCE CLEARS: the SoP is re-derivable from the primary filing without borrowing a sell-side target (unlike FIP), and the C$6.29B NCI is genuinely small relative to the common. BUT the "market cap < the C$25B sports group alone" framing is SoP sleight of hand — C$44B of net debt sits ahead of the common, so the sports mark only reaches holders if telecom EV clears the debt. Both remaining defects are correctly self-disclosed by the line: proceeds are explicitly earmarked to debt paydown (confirmed in Rogers' own language), and the likely structured-equity/preferred-return format would make the C$25B a financing cost rather than common-accretive value. Tradeable, no hidden disqualifier.

The line writes "$1,239.6M assets less $725.0M liabilities less $55.3M noncontrolling interest = $514.6M attributable," but $1,239.582M - $724.964M = $514.618M ALREADY - that figure IS total equity including the $55.282M NCI (FMP's own totalEquity=$569.9M line is internally inconsistent, since $724.964M + $569.900M = $1,294.9M != the $1,239.582M balance-sheet total; the identity check proves NCI sits inside $514.6M). Common-attributable net assets in liquidation are $459.3M, not $514.6M. On ~143.86M shares ($376.9M mcap / $2.62) that is ~$3.19/sh, not ~$3.58/sh - modeled upside falls from ~+37% to ~+22%, i.e. the claimed edge is overstated by roughly a third. Same error in the corroborating walk: Q1 attributable was $655.7M ($705.9M less $50.2M NCI), and $655.7M - $186.9M (143.86M sh x $1.30 paid 2026-06-03) = $468.8M vs $459.3M actual, so there IS a ~$9M residual erosion beyond the distribution plus NCI accreting $50.2M -> $55.3M, not the "dollar-for-dollar, no material write-down" claimed. WHAT CUTS THE SCORE: (a) the ~22% real spread over an undated 4-6 quarter tail is ~15% annualized before frictions, thin for an ACTIVE seat; (b) "net assets in liquidation" is a management self-mark with no court supervision, and a market paying 82% of it is pricing either disbelief in the residual real-estate marks or the time/wind-down drag - the widening discount is evidence, not noise; (c) provenance is second-hand - SEC EDGAR returned HTTP 403, so every balance-sheet figure is FMP's parse, and the preferred-OP-unit redemption value and wind-down cost accruals remain unverified at source; (d) no hard-dated next distribution exists; (e) the flag numerator "$1.16B of assets remain against a $377M market cap" is doubly misleading - $1.16B is the "otherAssets" bucket, and setting gross assets against equity market cap ignores the $725M of liabilities; (f) HIDDEN TRADEABILITY HAZARD the line never raises - serial partial liquidating distributions mechanically drop the quoted price, so any paper book that marks to price without crediting distributions will book large phantom losses on this name (the $1.30 June payment alone was ~33% of the then-price).

But note asymmetry: at $139 the stock already prices most of the win (49% upside to $208) vs ~57% downside to $60. EV barbell: 0.78*(208-139.31)+0.22*(60-139.31)= +$36.1/sh (~+26% EV). reference_rr=(208-139.31)/(139.31-60)=0.87.
